val chiselVersion = "6.7.0"

    name := "chisel_extra_bench",

    version := "1.0",

    scalacOptions ++= Seq(
      "-deprecation",
      "-unchecked",
      "-Ymacro-annotations"

    libraryDependencies ++= Seq(
      "org.chipsalliance" %% "chisel" % chiselVersion,
